records.title: Still an innovator with loads of smart features - but less coherent
records.review: I’ve banked with Monzo for a few years and some of my fears turned out to be unfounded; I tend to be able to get everything done through an iPhone app and have lived happily without desktop or browser access which I originally thought would be a problem. Monzo have some really innovative and smart products and good interest rates (Flex interest free credit deserves a particular shout out). In recent years though their rush to introduce lots of marketing gimmicks makes the core product confusing - they used to offer helpful budgeting tools through pots, but because they only offer separate savings accounts you can’t really use the pots to organise you money and get interest on it. The product feels a bit bloated, and things like free sausage rolls feel really gimmicky. But overall I haven’t found a better challenger bank. And they are good at dealing with fraud and account problems quickly. They’ve still got it.

records.title: WARNING
records.review:
My partner took out a loan and transferred the funds to me so I could pay off my existing debts in my home country and provide financial support to both of our families.

Because of the amount, my transfer was flagged and placed on hold. I immediately submitted the loan agreement and proof that the funds came from my partner. Despite providing everything they requested, my account is still on hold.

I was told they would let me know their decision, but it's now been five days. Every time I contact customer support, I receive the same generic response, with no updates and no clear timeline.

The most frustrating part is that while my money is being held, I'm the one who will have to deal with the consequences. I'll be charged interest for late payments on debts that I was ready to settle, simply because I cannot access my own funds. Those extra costs won't be covered by the bank.

This experience has been incredibly disappointing. Poor customer service, a lack of transparency, and no one seems willing to help or provide meaningful updates.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend using Monzo. I hope no one else has to go through this.

records.title: Absolutely love Monzo! 🧡
records.review:
From day one, Monzo has been an absolute pleasure for us to use, and moving everything over from the traditional banks has genuinely been one of the best financial decisions we’ve ever made. It’s our main bank now, and honestly, I can’t imagine going back.

What makes Monzo stand out for us is the whole experience. It’s modern, intuitive, incredibly easy to use and, most importantly, it actually makes banking enjoyable.

We especially love the Pots. We use them for everything, family holidays, Christmas, birthdays, home projects, future plans, weddings, special occasions, you name it. Being able to create as many different Pots as we need, give them their own names, add pictures that actually represent what we’re saving for, and even lock them until a certain date makes saving feel much more personal and motivating.

For example, if we’re saving for a holiday, we can put a beautiful beach picture on the Pot, or if it’s for a special occasion, we can choose an image that reminds us exactly what we’re working towards. It sounds like a small thing, but it genuinely makes saving more engaging. You actually enjoy watching those Pots grow, and it gives you that feeling that no goal is too big. You can dream about something, create a Pot for it and start working towards it.

And that’s something I really love about Monzo. It makes you feel like there’s no limit to what you can achieve. Whether it’s a family holiday, Christmas, a wedding, a Holy Communion, a home project or simply something you’ve always wanted to do, you can create a goal and start putting money aside for it.

Beyond the Pots, Monzo really does feel like a complete package. There’s everyday banking, savings and interest on eligible savings, cashback offers with selected retailers, the ability to invest, and even the option to refer friends and family who aren’t with Monzo yet, with eligible referral rewards currently ranging from £20 up to £100.

And I have to mention the kids too. Even they enjoy using Monzo, which I think is fantastic. They’re getting used to saving, setting goals and understanding money from a young age, but in a way that feels fun rather than like a lesson.

Of course, there are other digital banks out there, and companies like Revolut get a lot of attention, but for us, Monzo strikes the perfect balance between innovation, simplicity, practicality and actually making you enjoy managing your money.

For our family, Monzo has become so much more than just a bank account. It’s become the place where we organise our money, plan for the future, save for the things we love and work towards our goals.

We’re proudly Team Monzo, and we’re here to stay. 🧡

records.title: Will never change banks
records.review: Honestly, monzo is the best bank I’ve ever been with. Everything is so easy to use, easy to find, easy to track, easy to separate! So many free features especially “pots” which make separating your money for budgeting purposes so easy and it doesn’t affect your credit score like opening a second account. I recommend monzo to everyone!
